headline: Pedro Sánchez, on La Séptima: "I will tax owners who have empty homes or at prices that are not affordable"
summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez said he will tax owners who have empty homes or set prices that are not affordable. Housing access is a central issue of the general election campaign.
why: Housing tax policy affects the property market, rental supply and the valuations of real estate companies and banks with mortgage exposure.
